model.name: diagram.removeFromDiagram
model.description: R33.8 client (design 2207a55fe): the R33.6.5 action-bar remove-from-diagram verb -> removeFromDiagram(ref) resolves the open diagram (same heuristic as discoverRelated) -> POST /api/model/diagram/remove-view -> on ok re-render (rb-diagram-detail.render -> buildDiagramSvg/buildEdges): the box + ITS edges drop, remaining connectors recompute by construction (no dangling; full re-render is the authoritative reroute). INV-RM1 view-not-model / RM3 reuse. The ACTIONS_BY_TYPE.modelelement verb entry (design B) + wireDrawerActions dispatch else-if ride the existing R33.6.5 wireDrawerActions.
